label: MEASURED (pod CPU, AMD EPYC 9654, 48 vCPU quota; other streams' builds were running concurrently)
what: SharedHostBudget A/B: 8 threads x 200k random alloc/free 16B..32KiB, live set <=32 per thread. old = fbb6c6c76 SharedHostBudget (ThreadSafeAllocator mutex + HostBudgetAllocator) over page_allocator (the accepted combined route's child, resident_batch.zig:65). new = atomic SharedHostBudget over page_allocator, and over smp_allocator (this branch's production child).
reading: Every sub-256KiB allocation on the accepted combined route was an mmap/munmap (LargeBlockRecycler passes small blocks straight to its child). The mutex is secondary (atomic+page_allocator is no faster and doubles sys time); the child is the regression. smp child: ~50-90x less wall, ~100x fewer minor faults.
